changes.reason: Align PostgreSQL value/quota storage with the existing finite nonnegative JavaScript number contract and expose one atomic explicit migration for existing integer columns. Existing identities and constraints remain intact.

kubernetes.reason: Reuse the existing Node PostgreSQL/Drizzle provider. Numeric column widening is an explicit database migration and does not change host lifecycle or connections.
constraints: Apply the reviewed migration outside application startup before writing fractional or large values; plan for a table rewrite and exclusive lock.
Supply the existing PostgreSQL connection through the application; Lambda retains its existing invocation connection lifecycle.
Local PostgreSQL 16 regression coverage does not certify a Kubernetes deployment or an AWS Lambda deployment.
